title: クレーンゲーム大成功！

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: They're so soft 'n fluffy. Not t'mention they're cool to the touch, just like snow!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Being surrounded by all these Cuties sure makes me feel like I'm in the big city now!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Anyhoo… Hi, li'l Cuties! I'm Yukino Bijin, from Morioka! I can't wait t'get to know you all!
